messages:
Maya: heads up — FinEdge (enterprise, Dedicated) opened a P0. After the model variant rollout at 2026-03-18T02:00Z their embedding requests started returning 500s and latency spikes. Sales wants a committed path tonight. Can we triage hotfix vs next release? :eyes:
Simon: FinEdge is citing the SLA clause in the contract. They want either a hotfix or rollback within 6 hours. They're already pausing new requests unless we confirm plan.
Junaid: I dug into the logs — stack trace points to kv-cache deserialization in the new model variant. Repro steps attached below. Error rate jumped from 0.1% -> ~12% for their tenant. Minimal repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v2","input":["test"]}' returns 500 with `KVDeserializeError`.
Olga: thanks. quick question — is this only on Dedicated for FinEdge or also in Hosted?
Junaid: only their Dedicated pool so far, appears tied to model variant + Quantized KV shape change. Hosted not hitting it yet.
Olga: ok. two options: 1) hotfix: push a compatibility layer at serving runtime that falls back to legacy cache layout for affected model variant (small patch, canaryable), OR 2) rollback the model variant for that tenant to the previous model. Hotfix is preferable if we can test quickly.
Devon: SRE constraints — we can run a 5% canary to their Dedicated pool, monitor 1m error rate and tail latency. Need a runbook: if error rate > 1% sustained for 5m rollback. Also confirm we have snapshot backups of KV cache per node before any migration.
Maya: timeline ask from Sales: if we go hotfix, can we have a canary + rollback window within 3 hours? If not, roll back model and schedule hotfix next release.
Olga: estimate: patch + build + smoke tests ~90m, canary 30m, then ramp. So 3 hours is tight but possible if we parallelize QA + deploy. I can lead the patch. Need QA help to run the quick regressions.
Simon: I'll inform FinEdge we propose canary tonight, aiming for full restore within 3h, and will provide status updates every 30m. They want a comms template and a short SLA note.
Junaid: QA checklist I'm going to run: reproduce, run embedding load ~1k reqs/s on canary, validate KV integrity, run 5 test prompts hitting cache boundaries. I can start on the smoke tests now.
Olga: plan: 1) create feature-flagged runtime patch (flag: embed_kv_compat=true) 2) deploy to canary (5% of FinEdge Dedicated hosts) 3) monitor metrics (errors, p95 latency, kv-miss-rate) for 30m 4) if stable, ramp to 100% 5) if fail, toggle flag off & rollback variant. Rollback target: previous model image.
Devon: monitoring queries: Datadog metric errors.redwood.embedding.count{tenant:finedge}.rollup(sum,60) / requests.redwood.embedding.count{tenant:finedge}.rollup(sum,60) > 0.01 --> alert. I'll wire an alert channel #prod-ops and add paging for 15m.
Maya: communications: Simon will send the external note. Internally: we should post status in #customer-ops and update the case in Zendesk. Also log the decision for roadmap prioritization — if this is caused by model compatibility, we should add a model onboarding checklist item.
Simon: sending initial note to FinEdge now: "We are starting a canary tonight targeting 5% of your Dedicated capacity. We'll update every 30 minutes and will rollback if errors exceed threshold." will post copy here before sending. :+1:
deploy-bot: canary deployment queued: job id jd-20260318-42 (canary to 5% FinEdge Dedicated).
Olga: I'll cut the patch branch and post the PR link in 15m. Junaid/D: please be ready to kick off smoke tests once CI passes.
Maya: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for decisions. If we hit rollback, we'll schedule a full fix next week and update roadmap priority.
Simon: updated FinEdge: they acknowledged plan and asked for a postmortem after we close.
Devon: alert policy in place, I added the dashboard and dashboard link in #prod-ops.
Olga: PR posted: https://git.internal/r/redwood/serving/pulls/3789 — patch + feature flag. Starting build.
Junaid: smoke tests running now. so far 0.2% errors on canary (within threshold). I'll report at +30m.
Maya: copy. leaving this open until full ramp or rollback.
